description: This header file declares Vulkan-specific tensor copy operations, including transfers between CPU and Vulkan device tensors, utility functions for memory copying, and helpers for data type conversions related to Vulkan integration in ATen (PyTorch's tensor library).

methods.name: transfer_cpu_to_vulkan
methods.description: Transfers data from a CPU tensor to a Vulkan tensor.

methods.name: transfer_vulkan_to_cpu
methods.description: Transfers data from a Vulkan tensor to a CPU tensor.

methods.name: pack_cpu_to_vulkan
methods.description: Packs a CPU tensor into a Vulkan tensor format.

methods.name: pack_vulkan_to_cpu
methods.description: Packs a Vulkan tensor into a CPU tensor format.

methods.name: copy_
methods.description: Copies data from one tensor to another.

methods.name: to_vulkan
methods.description: Converts a CPU tensor to a Vulkan tensor.

methods.name: from_vulkan
methods.description: Converts a Vulkan tensor back to a CPU tensor.

methods.name: void memcpy_to_mapping_impl(const Tensor & src,api::MemoryMap & dst_mapping)
methods.description: Template function for copying data from a tensor to a memory mapping.

methods.name: void memcpy_from_mapping_impl(api::MemoryMap & src_mapping,Tensor & dst)
methods.description: Template function for copying data from a memory mapping to a tensor.

methods.name: void memcpy_from_mapping_bool(api::MemoryMap & src_mapping,Tensor & dst)
methods.description: Copies boolean data from a memory mapping to a tensor.

methods.name: void memcpy_to_mapping_uint8(const Tensor & src,api::MemoryMap & dst_mapping)
methods.description: Copies boolean tensor data into a uint8_t memory mapping.

methods.name: memcpy_to_mapping
methods.description: Copies tensor data to a memory mapping.

methods.name: memcpy_from_mapping
methods.description: Copies data from a memory mapping to a tensor.
